# CAST AI Appoints Pierre-Andre Liduena as Chief Financial Officer

_Pierre will oversee corporate strategy and financial operations, playing a pivotal role in CAST AI’s next chapter of growth_

CAST AI, the [leading Kubernetes automation platform](https://cast.ai/), today announced that Pierre-Andre Liduena has joined the company as Chief Financial Officer (CFO). Pierre is a seasoned finance, operations, and strategy executive and investor in hypergrowth, global companies.

> “We are thrilled to welcome Pierre-Andre to CAST AI and look forward to benefiting from his executive experience across finance, operations, strategy, and investor relations,” said CAST AI Co-Founder and CEO **Yuri Frayman**. “2023 was a record year for CAST AI, and 2024 holds even greater potential. Pierre-Andre will play a critical role in helping us fully capitalize, achieve our aggressive growth goals, and realize our mission to deliver a fully automated Kubernetes experience.”

In his role as CFO, Pierre will oversee CAST AI’s finance, legal, and operations teams. He has spent the last decade leading M&A, strategic investments and partnerships, and business development at Charter Communications; advised CFOs of portfolio companies on how to scale up financial operations and raise capital; and was a board member of several portfolio companies. Prior to joining Charter Communications, he was associate director at UBS Investment Bank, and an audit/transaction advisory manager at EY. He graduated from EDHEC Business School in France and holds an MBA from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.

> “CAST AI is in a unique position. The company has a seasoned leadership team and a superior platform with an unparalleled roadmap. CAST AI is experiencing rapid growth in all geographies and is backed by industry-leading investors,” said **Liduena**. “I’ve spent my career developing expertise in finance, operations, and strategy, and couldn’t be more excited to bring my collective experiences together to help further accelerate CAST AI’s growth.”

#### About Cast AI

Cast AI is the leading Kubernetes automation platform for cloud-native and AI infrastructure. The company achieved unicorn status in January 2026 following a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the U.S.-based corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group, an over $50 billion Korean conglomerate with leading business across retail, consumer, and digital platforms. Cast AI is trusted by BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, and Swisscom to keep mission-critical applications reliable and performant at scale.
